title: Quiz — Governance, Risk, and Compliance Artifacts

questions.q: Which artifact sets a mandatory and measurable minimum level?
questions.explain: A standard enforces a verifiable level. A guideline or advisory recommends without mandating.

questions.q: A document describes the exact steps to revoke an account after an employee's departure. Which artifact is this?
questions.explain: An SOP is a repeatable sequence of steps. A standard sets a target state; a BCP organizes business continuity.

questions.q: Which elements fall under guidelines? (Select all that apply)
questions.explain: All four are listed under Guidelines in objective 5.1: they guide decisions without imposing an obligation.

questions.q: Match each artifact to the question it answers.

pairs.right: How to perform the action, step by step?
Who does what in an exceptional situation?

questions.explain: The documentation pyramid reads from general intent (policy) to recovery organization (plan).

questions.q: Which policy defines the conditions for using a personal device to access the information system?
questions.explain: A BYOD policy governs personal device usage: enrollment, compliance, access, and revocation.

questions.q: Which lifecycle stage grants a policy its formal authority?
questions.explain: Approval by executive leadership makes the document enforceable. Publication alone does not create an obligation.
